title: Remote Work Policy
content: Acme Corp employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with manager approval. Fully remote arrangements require VP sign-off and are reviewed quarterly.

title: Paid Time Off (PTO)
content: Full-time employees accrue 15 PTO days per year, increasing to 20 days after 3 years of tenure. PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance via the HR portal.

title: Expense Reimbursement
content: Business expenses under $75 do not require pre-approval but must be submitted with a receipt within 30 days. Expenses over $75 require manager pre-approval before the purchase is made.

title: VPN Access
content: All remote connections to internal systems must go through the corporate VPN client. VPN credentials are issued by IT on your first day and rotate every 90 days.

title: Password Reset Procedure
content: Employees can reset their AcmeChat SSO password via the self-service portal at password.acme.internal. IT help desk resets are only available for accounts locked after 5 failed attempts.

title: Parental Leave
content: Acme Corp offers 16 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for the secondary caregiver, available within the first 12 months after birth or adoption.

title: Laptop Refresh Cycle
content: Company laptops are refreshed every 3 years. Employees can request an early refresh through IT if hardware issues impact productivity, subject to manager approval.

title: Wifi and Office Network Access
content: Guests can access the Acme-Guest wifi network without a badge. Employees should use Acme-Secure, authenticated via SSO, for access to internal resources.

title: Code of Conduct - Data Handling
content: Employees must not share customer data outside of approved internal tools. Any suspected data handling incident must be reported to the Security team within 24 hours.

title: Travel Booking Policy
content: All business travel must be booked through the Acme Travel portal. Flights should be economy class for trips under 6 hours; exceptions require VP approval.
